form.label: Databricks Security - Posture
form.description: Security posture of the Databricks estate: 32 checks modelled on the Security Analysis Tool, scored and refreshed by the Databricks Security Posture job (every 6 hours by default). Click a check title for the Databricks security best practice, a recommendation for the remediation documentation.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT s.score_pct, round(coalesce(t.score_pct, s.score_pct), 1) AS score_pct_7d_ago, s.checks, s.checks_failed, s.high_checks_failed, s.high_findings, s.medium_findings, s.low_findings, s.total_findings, round((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(r.refreshed_at)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_since_refresh FROM $sp$.posture_score s CROSS JOIN (SELECT max(refreshed_at) AS refreshed_at FROM $sp$.security_findings_latest) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT score_pct FROM $sp$.posture_trend WHERE snapshot_date <= current_date() - 7 ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1) t ON TRUE WHERE s.category = 'ALL'"
| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT category FROM $sp$.check_results GROUP BY category ORDER BY min(category_order)"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(CAST(snapshot_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS epoch, score_pct, high_findings, medium_findings, low_findings FROM $sp$.posture_trend WHERE snapshot_date > current_date() - 90 ORDER BY snapshot_date" | eval _time=tonumber(epoch) | timechart span=1d max(score_pct) as "Score %"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(CAST(snapshot_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS epoch, score_pct, high_findings, medium_findings, low_findings FROM $sp$.posture_trend WHERE snapshot_date > current_date() - 90 ORDER BY snapshot_date" | eval _time=tonumber(epoch) | timechart span=1d max(high_findings) as HIGH max(medium_findings) as MEDIUM max(low_findings) as LOW

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT category, min(category_order) AS category_order, round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN severity_weight ELSE 0 END) / sum(severity_weight), 1) AS score_pct, count(*) AS checks, count_if(status = 'FAIL') AS failing, count_if(status = 'FAIL' AND severity = 'HIGH') AS high_failing, count_if(status = 'FAIL' AND severity = 'MEDIUM') AS medium_failing, count_if(status = 'FAIL' AND severity = 'LOW') AS low_failing, sum(findings) AS findings FROM $sp$.check_results GROUP BY category ORDER BY category_order"

table.fields: category, score_pct, checks, failing, high_failing, medium_failing, low_failing, findings

panel.title: Security checks
panel.description: Click a title: Databricks security best practice. Click a recommendation: remediation documentation.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT status, severity, check_id, category, title, findings, affected_workspaces, recommendation, sat_reference, best_practice_url, doc_url FROM $sp$.check_results WHERE ('$category$' = '*' OR category = '$category$') ORDER BY status = 'FAIL' DESC, severity_order, findings DESC, check_id"

table.fields: status, severity, check_id, category, title, findings, affected_workspaces, recommendation, sat_reference

panel.title: Findings
panel.description: Every failing object at the last refresh, filtered by category and severity.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT severity, check_id, title, category, workspace_name, object_type, object_name, detail, unix_timestamp(detected_at) AS detected_epoch, recommendation, doc_url FROM $sp$.security_findings_latest WHERE ('$severity$' = '*' OR severity = '$severity$') AND ('$category$' = '*' OR category = '$category$') ORDER BY severity_order, check_id, detected_at DESC LIMIT 2000" | eval detected_at=strftime(tonumber(detected_epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

table.fields: severity, check_id, title, workspace_name, object_type, object_name, detail, detected_at, recommendation

panel.title: Security activity: last 7 days vs previous 7 days

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT metric_label, metric_order, sum(CASE WHEN event_date > current_date() - 7 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS last_7_days, sum(CASE WHEN event_date <= current_date() - 7 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS previous_7_days FROM $sp$.activity_kpis_daily WHERE event_date > current_date() - 14 GROUP BY metric_label, metric_order ORDER BY metric_order" | eval change=last_7_days - previous_7_days
